name: Site watch
author: ModuForge
description: Checks your sites every few minutes, shows which are up and how fast they answer, and posts a notification when one goes down or comes back. The list of sites and the interval are asked once and can be changed on the module's screen.

permissionReasons.NETWORK_OUTBOUND: Opens the addresses you listed, and only those.
permissionReasons.FILE_SANDBOXED: Keeps the last state of each site to notice a change.
permissionReasons.NOTIFICATIONS: Tells you when a site goes down or comes back.
permissionReasons.BACKGROUND_EXECUTION: Keeps checking while the app is not on screen.
